[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The index records Wilhilmina Colquhouv Robertson, also indexed as Wilhilmina Colquhouv Glasgow, baptised at Kilwinning on 29 July 1840. It names R. Robertson Glasgow and Mary Wilhimina Campbell as her parents.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/179686 Ancestry, Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950: Wilhilmina Colquhouv Robertson, record 60143/179686].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The index uses both Robertson and Glasgow for the child. This baptism does not identify her in later life.

[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The census index lists John Glascow, also indexed as John Glasgow, aged 65, at 23 Eastbourne Avenue, Walker. He was a joiner and gave Edinburgh as his birthplace.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/2352/records/35265007 Ancestry, 1911 England Census: John Glascow, record 2352/35265007].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The 1911 index gives his age as 65 and birthplace as Edinburgh. His identity in earlier records is unresolved.
